Offboard an Employee

User manual · English · 10 steps
Learn how to register an employee's departure: open their record, choose the departure reason and details, decide what happens to their leave and contract, and archive them.

1. Open Employees

Open the Employees app.

2. Open the employee

Click the card of the employee who is leaving.

3. Actions menu

Click the gear icon to open the Actions menu.

4. Archive

Click Archive.

5. Departure reason

Click the field and type the first letters of what you are looking for.

ℹ️ Type at least two letters of what you are looking for.

6. Choose the reason

Click the result you want in the list.

7. Detailed reason

Type a short note about the departure, then click anywhere outside the box.

8. Departure date

Click the date field to check the departure date.

9. Apply

Click Apply to register the departure.

10. Departure registered

The employee is now archived. Click the name to finish.
